none: PAS CAM-E236B0: Copper-alloy Dupondius Roman Coin of Trajan
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [...]RVA TRA[...] ; R/ [TR POT COS II/III PP SC]

A copper-alloy Dupondius of Trajan, 98-117. Mint is Rome, 98-100, Reece period 5. Obverse shows raiate head right. Obverse legend reads [...]RVA TRA[...]. Reverse shows ? Abundantia seated left. Reverse legend reads [TR POT COS II/III PP SC]. Die axis is uncertain, weight is 12.69g, diameter is 27.07mm. See: c.f. RIC II, pp.272-274, 382 passim
